title: Mara and the Wreck
author: P. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Mirabel Voss, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
